visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: A Generator Instead of an Output List Parameter
visualizerParams.problemDescription: inorder fills a list passed in as a parameter. Make it a generator with yield from and build the list with list(). The output must stay the same.
visualizerParams.initialCode:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, key):
        self.key = key
        self.left = None
        self.right = None


def inorder(root, out):
    if root is not None:
        inorder(root.left, out)
        out.append(root.key)
        inorder(root.right, out)


root = Node(4)
root.left = Node(2)
root.right = Node(6)
root.left.left = Node(1)
root.left.right = Node(3)
result = []
inorder(root, result)
print(result)

solution.code:
class Node:
    def __init__(self, key):
        self.key = key
        self.left = None
        self.right = None


def inorder(root):
    if root is not None:
        yield from inorder(root.left)
        yield root.key
        yield from inorder(root.right)


root = Node(4)
root.left = Node(2)
root.right = Node(6)
root.left.left = Node(1)
root.left.right = Node(3)
print(list(inorder(root)))
solution.explanation: A generator hands out the keys one at a time, so the caller decides what to do with them (a list, a loop, a sum) and no output parameter is needed.
